caption: Toda-Yamamoto Granger F-statistics at lags 1–12, both directions. SPY → M2 YoY growth (blue, the REVERSE direction) clears the 5% critical line at lags [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8]; M2 YoY growth → SPY (pale blue, the forward direction) clears it at NONE (all p > 0.43). The market leads the money aggregate, not the other way around — M2 is coincident/lagging, so this is NOT a forward forecasting signal.
